note: Invented: mixing a shared glaze bucket, from the glaze table to the kiln.
intro: Mixing a new glaze bucket takes three people. The seat changes hands once, at the signed-off batch sheet.
label: Mixing a glaze bucket

steps.name: Weigh the dry batch
steps.done: every material is on the batch sheet to the gram.
steps.fail: A material runs short: stop, write the shortfall on the sheet and tell the lead.

steps.name: Sieve and mix
steps.done: the slop passes an 80-mesh sieve twice with no grit.
steps.fail: Grit stays in the sieve: re-mix for ten minutes, then sieve again.

steps.name: Sign off the batch sheet
steps.done: the lead has initialled the sheet and shelved the bucket.
steps.fail: A reading is outside its range: the bucket goes back to G2, not on the shelf.

steps.name: Fire a test tile
steps.done: the tile is back from cone 6 and photographed.
steps.fail: The tile crawls or runs: label the bucket Hold and tell the lead.

seam.label: The kiln technician takes the bucket
